title: Join Us for the Grand Opening of 3D Systems' Industrial Technology Center
body_markdown:
**Wednesday, October 21**
3D Systems Littleton Campus
5381 S. Alkire Street, Littleton, CO 80127
**1:30 PM – 5:30 PM**


3D Systems is delighted to invite you to celebrate the grand opening of our newly expanded Industrial Technology Center in Littleton, Colorado.


This special event marks a significant milestone in our continued investment in expanding American manufacturing capability for Aerospace and Defense and Semiconductor equipment. Be among the first to experience our new state-of-the-art facility, designed to support the growing demand for mission-critical, high-performance 3D printing solutions.


The afternoon will feature an official ribbon cutting ceremony, guided facility tours, and opportunities to see firsthand how 3D Systems is advancing innovation from prototype to production. Guests will also have the opportunity to connect with 3D Systems executives, industry leaders, customers, partners, and local government officials.


Enjoy refreshments, engage in meaningful networking conversations, and discover how 3D printing is transforming the future of manufacturing.


We look forward to welcoming you and sharing this exciting new chapter with you.


**Register today to reserve your place.**


**Event Agenda**


1:30 PM ----- Doors Open


2:00 PM ----- Welcome Remarks


2:15 PM ----- Ribbon cutting


2:17 PM ----- Refreshments & Reception begin


2:30 PM ----- Facility Tours begin


5:30 PM ----- Event ends
